whenToUse: Screens where a paper metaphor fits, such as missions, coupons, or stamp cards.
Finished cards stay in the list as they are.
whenNotToUse: Approval marks on serious work documents.
It would cover text and make it hard to read.
It would stamp several cards at once.

alternatives.name: Success Checkmark
alternatives.reason: Reporting with a check instead of a stamp.

accessibility: The stamp is aria-hidden, and completion is announced with a role=status message.
It has pointer-events: none, so it doesn't block the card's buttons.
With reduced motion, it appears at once without coming down.
Keep enough contrast between the stamp color and the background.
